# Vendored, not fetched

The dashboard's chart library, copied in rather than loaded from a CDN, so the
page draws on a laptop with no internet. Nothing updates these files
automatically; a new version is a deliberate copy and a change to the line
below.

- uPlot 1.6.32, MIT, https://github.com/leeoniya/uplot
  - `uPlot.iife.min.js` from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/uplot@1.6.32/dist/uPlot.iife.min.js
  - `uPlot.min.css`    from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/uplot@1.6.32/dist/uPlot.min.css
  - Fetched 2026-08-13.
